# Obadiah

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Obadiah announces judgment upon Edom for pride and mistreatment of God's people. The book teaches that God's justice ultimately prevails over arrogant nations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Obadiah 1:3</div>

<div class="identifier">The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Most quoted verse in the book

### Chapter Insight

This chapter pronounces judgment against Edom for its pride and mistreatment of Judah while promising the ultimate restoration and victory of God's people. The key verse emphasizes that pride and false security inevitably lead to downfall before God.
:::
